what_to_detect: The resolution of a cumulative upkeep (or any upkeep-payment keyword) trigger puts an age counter on the permanent and then either has the full per-counter cost paid or sacrifices the permanent; the fires side is the sacrifice because the cost was not paid in full. The trigger is keyword-derived, stored as its bare keyword with no Mode$. outcome_event with api Keyword is no substitute: it would count every keyword-line resolution that sacrifices (echo, fading, vanishing) as this rule's.
near_miss: The same keyword trigger resolution in which the controller pays and the permanent stays.
record_fields: sidecar line keyword (bare keyword, no Mode$)

what_to_detect: Each instance of a keyword trigger such as cumulative upkeep resolves separately, and the payment asked is scaled by all age counters present at that resolution; the fires side is the resolution that sacrifices because the total was not paid. outcome_event with api Keyword is no substitute: it would count every keyword-line resolution that sacrifices (echo, fading, vanishing) as this rule's.
near_miss: Resolutions of the instances in which the whole cost is paid and the permanent stays.
record_fields: two trigger records sharing a source
